snippet.title: Evil School Launch Date Set for August 14 — Unpaid Blood Debts, The Hunt Begins!
snippet.description:
Dear fellow players,
Thank you for your attention and anticipation for Evil School! We are officially announcing that the full version of Evil School will launch on August 14th!
Demo released, enjoy it in Steam Next Fest!
